stem: Which traction method is specifically used for babies with a femoral shaft fracture?
explanation: Gallows traction is the correct method for babies with a femoral shaft fracture. It is the traction specifically listed for infants in this setting.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 156

optionExplanations.A: Correct because gallows traction is specifically used for babies with femoral shaft fractures.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because collar and cuff is used for selected upper-limb injuries, not femoral shaft fractures.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because broad arm sling is used for clavicle or scapular injuries, not lower-limb fractures.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because a below-knee back-slab is for distal lower-limb injuries, not femoral shaft fractures.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because Thomas splint is used for proximal femur or femoral shaft fractures in older children, not specifically babies.
